description: We use an automated tool that screens CVs and ranks job applicants for our recruiters, who normally interview the top ten.
rationale: The tool screens CVs and ranks applicants so recruiters interview only the top ten, which is the Annex III point 4(a) use case of filtering applications and evaluating candidates. Because the ranking materially shapes who advances, the Article 6(3) derogation is unlikely to apply.

basis.quote: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons

proposed.text: Inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting the system into service or using it at the workplace
proposed.quote: shall inform workers’ representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system

proposed.text: Inform natural persons that they are subject to the high-risk AI system when it makes or assists in making decisions about them
proposed.quote: deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that make decisions or assist in making decisions related to natural persons shall inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system

proposed.text: Assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, with the necessary support
proposed.quote: Deployers shall assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, as well as the necessary support.

proposed.text: Use the system in accordance with the provider's instructions for use
proposed.quote: shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying the systems

proposed.text: Ensure input data is relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose, where the deployer controls the input data
proposed.quote: that deployer shall ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative in view of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system

proposed.text: Monitor the system's operation and suspend use and inform the provider and authority if it may present a risk
proposed.quote: Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use

proposed.text: Keep automatically generated logs under the deployer's control for at least six months
proposed.quote: shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control, for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months

proposed.text: Carry out a fundamental rights impact assessment before first use and notify the market surveillance authority of the results
proposed.quote: The obligation laid down in paragraph 1 applies to the first use of the high-risk AI system.

Because the ranking materially shapes who advances, the Article 6(3) derogation is unlikely to apply.

- Monitor the system's operation and suspend use and inform the provider and authority if it may present a risk [ai-act/art-26#2] "Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use"
